trainedOn: clean-tos (24 clips, 96 s, Tears of Steel CC BY 3.0), synthetic positives
notes: Experiment-grade. Trained on one film, with JPEG standing in for H.264 recompression and no collected hard negatives. Its false-positive rate is far from prd.md §5.2.5a and it has never been evaluated against real mosaicked footage. Do not treat its output as production quality.
